## Prompt (south-west single)

Create a single ultra-crisp 16-bit GBA/DS pixel-art sprite (1376x768) on a pure solid white background (#FFFFFF) of a small, slim dark charcoal grey rat (#4A4F48, highlights #646C60, shadows #323832, outline #0D0D0D) standing upright on its two hind legs in a slightly crouched pose: a big head with exactly TWO large triangular ears (pale blue-grey inside #95A8A7), small red eyes (#E73D3D), a pointed snout with two small white front teeth (#F3F3F3), a thick fluffy pale tan cheek ruff (#DCC8A3 / #BF9B7B), a tan belly patch, exactly TWO thin arms with light-brown hands (#BF9B7B), and exactly ONE long thin tail curling up behind the body, ending in one curled tuft of fur.

LEG RULE (most important): the creature stands on exactly TWO hind legs, so exactly TWO feet touch the ground — one near foot (lower left) and one far foot (slightly right, a little higher). No third or fourth foot, no front legs on the ground. The two hands are held up in front of the chest, they never touch the ground.

View: SOUTH-WEST 3/4 quarter view, halfway between facing the viewer and facing left: the face looks diagonally down-left with both eyes visible in natural 3/4 perspective (not squished), the cheek ruff and belly visible, the single tail behind the body to the right curling up above the right hip. Exactly one tail, two ears, two arms, two legs, two feet. Crisp 1-2px dark outline, limited palette, no anti-aliasing.
